description: This file provides byte order conversion functions, including byte swapping and endianness utilities, for the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: gbswap_64
methods.description: Byte swap a 64-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: gbswap_32
methods.description: Byte swap a 32-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: gbswap_16
methods.description: Byte swap a 16-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: ghtons
methods.description: Convert 16-bit host to network byte order, depending on endianness.

methods.name: ghtonl
methods.description: Convert 32-bit host to network byte order, depending on endianness.

methods.name: ghtonll
methods.description: Convert 64-bit host to network byte order, depending on endianness.

methods.name: gntohs
methods.description: Convert 16-bit network to host byte order.

methods.name: gntohl
methods.description: Convert 32-bit network to host byte order.

methods.name: gntohll
methods.description: Convert 64-bit network to host byte order.
